class NumberPlaneScaled(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        number_plane = NumberPlane(
            x_range=(-4, 11, 1),
            y_range=(-3, 3, 1),
            x_length=5,
            y_length=2,
        ).move_to(LEFT*3)

        number_plane_scaled_y = NumberPlane(
            x_range=(-4, 11, 1),
            x_length=5,
            y_length=4,
        ).move_to(RIGHT*3)

        self.add(number_plane)
        self.add(number_plane_scaled_y)
